description: Search the Smarter Weather developer documentation index (quickstart, REST API, MCP server, errors, rate limits, SDKs, pricing, API keys). Returns up to 5 matching entries with title, URL, and an actionable summary. No authentication required.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "authenticate rest api" (max 200 chars)

name: get_documentation
title: Search Smarter Weather documentation

description: Current developer-platform plans and pricing: Free, Developer, and Professional tiers with monthly price, included API-call allowance, and overage rates. One metered allowance spans REST and MCP usage. No authentication required.
name: get_plans
title: Get Smarter Weather developer plans

description: Returns the Smarter Weather developer sign-up URL (with MCP referral attribution). Present the URL so the user can create a free account in a browser (Clerk, no credit card). After they finish, reconnect this MCP server with OAuth and call create_api_key, then configure_mcp. No authentication required.
name: sign_up

widget.description: sw-ui-spec widget block rendered by the MCP Apps onboarding widget (ui://onboarding-widget/v1/index.html). Additive; safe to ignore.

title: Get the Smarter Weather sign-up URL

description: Does not mint from the hosted server. Prefer `npx -y @smarterweather/mcp-onboarding@latest trial` (no MCP host), or add the stdio bridge and call start_trial there. Both write SMARTERWEATHER_API_KEY to .env and never print the bearer. If you already run the package and still see this, restart it on @latest.
name: start_trial
title: Start a Smarter Weather trial API key
